chapter_title_en: The Ambush of the Flood Dragons
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 527 – The Ambush of the Flood Dragons
chapter_meta_description: The Seamless Gate springs a trap, unleashing three hidden Flood Dragon formations. But the Xia Emperor counters with nine Xingtian incarnations. A shocking reversal shatters the front line.
og_title: The Ambush of the Flood Dragons
og_description: The Seamless Gate springs a trap with hidden Flood Dragon formations. The Xia Emperor counters with nine Xingtian incarnations, but an unexpected turn leads to a devastating breakthrough.
twitter_description: A trap within a trap! The Seamless Gate and Grand Xia clash in a massive formation war, but a lone Flood Dragon proves far more powerful than expected, shattering a Xingtian incarnation.

lore_anchors.definition: An ancient beast formation used by the Seamless Gate, comparable in power to the Grand Xia's Xingtian Formation, comprised of thousands of Celestial Immortals and countless Loose Immortals.
A massive war formation requiring 100,000 Loose Immortals and 1,000 Celestial Immortals to create a temporary divine spirit with god-tier power.
The Grand Xia army's mobile headquarters, a portable treasure world carried by the Xingtian incarnation to deploy reinforcements instantly.
A high-level spatial treasure that contains an independent world, allowing armies to be hidden and deployed at a moment's notice.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't the Grand Xia escape the ambush?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Xia Emperor anticipated the trap and had the Eight Dragon Cloud City hidden on the front-line Xingtian incarnation, allowing him to instantly counter-ambush with his own reserves.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why was one Flood Dragon so much stronger?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The chapter implies that the particular Flood Dragon that shattered the Xingtian incarnation had a more powerful core, likely an ultra-elite commander or a specialized version of the formation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What happens to the Immortals when a Xingtian incarnation is destroyed?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The formation's core, the Celestial and Loose Immortals inside the construct's body, are exposed and brutally slaughtered, representing a catastrophic loss.
